filings.summary: IZMO Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated October 07, 2026, titled "izmo Microsystems and IIT Madras Enter Phase II of ₹99.94 Crore MeitY-Sanctioned Silicon Photonics Program".

headlines.headline: TCS Q2 results: Net profit rises 15% to ₹13,884 crore, revenue jumps 11% YoY; TCV rises to $9.6 billion
headlines.summary: TCS posted a 15% YoY rise in profits in the Q2 results, along with a ₹12/share second interim dividend for shareholders on Thursday, October 8.

headlines.headline: TCS board declared second interim dividend of ₹12 per share; check record date
headlines.summary: The second interim dividend, TCS said, will be paid on Friday, October 30, 2026, to the eligible equity shareholders of the company.

headlines.headline: SENSEX tanks over 1,100 pts, NIFTY trades below 22,200; Senco Gold, TCS, Fino Payments Bank among buzzing stocks
headlines.summary: Shares of Fino Payments Bank rallied as much as 16.8% to hit an intraday high of ₹150.40 per unit, as the Bank reported a 13% YoY surge in its average total deposits to ₹2,794 crore in Q2 FY27.

headlines.headline: TCS Q2 results: Revenue and net profit could see single-digit growth sequentially; key focus on AI business and interim dividend
headlines.summary: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) will announce its Q2FY27 results on Thursday, October 8, 2026, after market hours. The IT major is expected to report low single-digit sequential growth in revenue and net profit. Investors will track deal wins, AI revenue, margin trends and the second interim dividend.

headlines.headline: IT stocks shine: TCS, Mphasis, Coforge, Infosys, others power Nifty IT up 2.2% despite overall weak market; here's why
headlines.summary: IT stocks surged during the trading session on October 8 amid a weak overall market as investors focused on the upcoming TCS earnings and IT sector momentum.

headlines.headline: ITC shares tumble 4% after reports of ₹9,400 crore block deal: What we know so far
headlines.summary: According to news reports, a block deal worth around ₹9,400 crore took place in ITC. GQG is likely to have been the seller, while a banker indicated that it was a “clean-out trade”, suggesting that the overhang from the stake sale has been cleared.

headlines.headline: Q2 results: TCS, Onix Solar Energy, GM Breweries, others to post earnings on October 8, check list
headlines.summary: NBFC Grand Oak Canyons Distillery, chocolate manufacturer Lotus Chocolate Company, railway construction firm K&R Rail Engineering and home loan provider Ind Bank Housing will also release their latest Q2 report cards.

headlines.headline: HDFC Bank declines after foreign investors cut 2.43% stake in September quarter; shares down 29% YTD
headlines.summary: HDFC Bank shares declined on October 8, as the latest shareholding pattern data showed that foreign investors cut their stakeholding in the private sector lender.

headlines.headline: SENSEX drops over 300 points, NIFTY50 opens at 22,599; SBI Life, Bajaj Finance down, while IT stocks lead gainers
headlines.summary: Indian equity indices declined after the opening bell on Thursday, October 8, amid the selloff cues from Asian markets, elevated oil prices, and rising US Treasury yields.

headlines.headline: TCS shares gain 3% ahead of Q2 results: What could turn around the stock after a 34% fall in 2026?
headlines.summary: TCS is kicking off the September-quarter earnings season for India’s major IT companies, with investors closely watching deal wins, AI-led revenue growth, margins, and management commentary on the demand environment and the outlook for the second half of FY27.

headlines.headline: Stocks to watch, Oct 8: Tata Power, TCS, Tata Steel, Senco Gold, PC Jeweller, Eveready Industries, Jubilant FoodWorks
headlines.summary: India Inc's second-quarter (Q2 FY27) earnings season officially kicks off today. Companies slated to announce their September quarter numbers include TCS, GM Breweries, Grand Oak Canyons Distillery, Onix Solar Energy, Lotus Chocolate Company, KR Rail Engineering, and Ind Bank Housing.

headlines.headline: TCS Q2 results in focus: Five key things investors need to track in quarterly earnings on October 8
headlines.summary: TCS is set to announce its Q2 results after market hours on October 8, as investors look forward to the IT bellwether’s performance potential amid sectoral headwinds. Here's all investors need to know ahead of the quarterly results.

headlines.headline: HUL Q2 FY27 results schedule: Check date, share price trend and key details
headlines.summary: During the previous quarter, on the margin front, HUL had highlighted that commodity volatility continues, with inflationary pressures expected to persist in the near term.

headlines.headline: Rate-sensitive shares, PVR Inox, Airtel among buzzing stocks as SENSEX slumps over 500 pts; NIFTY trades below 22,600
headlines.summary: Dilip Buildcon’s stock rose as much as 3.6% to touch the session’s high of ₹415.20 per equity share on October 7, as it bagged an order worth ₹1,800 crore from the Petroleum and Natural Gas Regulatory Board (PNGRB).

headlines.headline: L&T arm bags major order worth up to ₹10,000 crore for thermal power plants in Jharkhand; stock trades lower
headlines.summary: L&T said as India’s electricity demand continues to rise, advanced thermal technologies can play an important role in providing reliable baseload power.
